<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that disconnects an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid into an aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid (Doebner modification). The forward reaction forms a C‑C double bond and a new aromatic carboxylic acid while breaking an aldehyde and a malonic carboxylic acid.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "aromatic carboxylic acid"]
}
</action_input>
